versions.content: Length restriction for short names of Identifiable Type: Valid Description: Short Names of Identifiable shall be restricted to total length of 128 characters. Rationale: Short Names partly used for the creation of C Language Names. These created names shall have a predictable maximum length to avoid tool problems. (Even if this length will greater than MISRA guideline recommendation it shall not be infinite.) Use Case: -- Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: A rule restricting the number of characters to 128 is already present in the MetaModel. [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z_0-9]{0-127}
